findings: P1: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_ui.go:301 | root cause: absent X-NRE-Operation-Key synthesizes a stable action/suffix key, and ui/app.js sendJSON never sends a unique key, so a second rotate of the same suffix reuses mappingOperationKey (epoch unchanged) and RotateMappingToken replays the first committed Vault outcome instead of storing the new token; the same synthesis also exceeds refPattern (128) for long suffixes and returns 403 | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/ui/app.js:14, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:237, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:540, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_ui_test.go:59 | impact: authorized rotate from the dedicated page does not keep the last successful token; long suffixes cannot be rotated, deleted, or opened via the page fallback key | minimal fix: mint a unique per-gesture OperationKey when the header is absent and/or have sendJSON send one; lock a second rotate and a long-suffix write

P1: plugins/cloudflare-dns/README.md:15 | root cause: the UI only rereads live in-memory Service.mappings; NewService/activate start empty and do not reload last save; the restart test is newMappingHandler identity | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/service.go:48, plugins/cloudflare-dns/controller.go:186, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_ui_test.go:66 | impact: Recipe outcome 刷新或重启后仍是最后一次成功保存 fails across plugin Stop/Activate or process restart | minimal fix: persist or reload mappings across Service reconstruction and replace the identity handler with a NewService/Stop-Activate assertion

P2[advisory]: plugins/cloudflare-dns/ui/index.html:49 | root cause: create/rotate forms omit method, so a no-JS submit is GET and puts the token in the query string | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/ui/index.html:68, plugins/cloudflare-dns/ui/app.js:29 | impact: if app.js does not run, Token material is exported in the URL | minimal fix: set method=post on token-bearing forms and keep preventDefault
result.summary: Reviewed T-mapping-ui local_change across all 3 pages (README/controller/mapping_ui, tests/app.js/index.html, style.css) plus adjacent mapping store, authorization, NewService/activate, and entrypoint mount. Checked authorized CRUD, unauth/anonymous/read-only denial, token redaction (list/detail/edit/error/audit), confirm/cancel and duplicate conflict, refresh vs Stop/Activate persistence, page write-path OperationKey vs Vault exactly-once, long-suffix refPattern, excluded DNS/zone-token/ui.schema surfaces, and inactive Controller 503.
